reviewMethod: Reviewed a labeled 19-image contact sheet of coordinate-centered 2024 USDA NAIP crops for Carlsbad and Oceanside. Four inherited points were recentered from official addresses and reviewed OpenStreetMap geometry before a second visual review. Each selection depicts the named destination or representative mapped trail segment; source, acquisition, and public-domain metadata remain in the candidate file.
